item.title: [BREAKING] [WFLA News Channel 8] Multiple people dead after shooting at fast food restaurant in southern Idaho
item.description: BOISE, Idaho (AP) — A shooting at an In-N-Out Burger restaurant in southern Idaho on Saturday afternoon left multiple people dead and others injured, police said. The shooter was among the dead, Twin Falls Police Chief Matthew Hicks said in a news conference. Police were still trying to determine the shooter’s identity and motive. “We [...]

item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] All 10 climbers swept away in avalanche in Pakistan are confirmed dead
item.description: Renowned British-Nepali climber Nirmal Purja and nine other climbers swept away by an avalanche in Pakistan are confirmed to have died, and search teams are trying to recover their bodies, Purja's expedition company said Saturday.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Stray bullet injures person inside Hillsborough County home: HCSO
item.description: A person was hospitalized after a stray bullet entered a Hillsborough County home Saturday evening, according to the Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office (HCSO).

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Multiple people dead after shooting at fast food restaurant in southern Idaho
item.description: Authorities in say a shooting at an In-N-Out Burger restaurant in southern Idaho has resulted in multiple people dead and others injured.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Professional boxing coach chases American dream in Tampa Bay
item.description: Nearly three decades after starting, Jessy Ross Thompson has built a reputation as one of the few people in professional boxing working at the highest level as both a head coach and cutman, training some of the best fighters in the world.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Community Steps Up After Tragedy Leaves 10-Year-Old Hospitalized
item.description: After weeks in the hospital, 10-year-old Asher Thompson continues to make progress in his recovery. On Saturday, neighbors, local businesses and community organizations gathered at W. H. Jack Mitchell Park to help ease the financial burden facing his family as he prepares for the next stage of treatment.
